contract.title: ERA5 hourly pressure-level slice: temperature and geopotential fields, January 2024
contract.intent: Retrieve a small ERA5 pressure-level reanalysis slice using temperature at 500 and 850 hPa and geopotential at 500 hPa, sampled every 3 hours during 2024-01-01 through 2024-01-31.
contract.summary: Copernicus Climate Data Store ERA5 hourly gridded reanalysis on pressure levels, restricted to January 2024, UTC times 00:00/03:00/06:00/09:00/12:00/15:00/18:00/21:00, temperature at 500 and 850 hPa, and geopotential at 500 hPa. Geography defaults to global because no sub-region was specified.
access_methods: Climate Data Store web download form
Climate Data Store API via cdsapi or Retrieve API
credential_requirements: Accept applicable CDS dataset terms before download

fields.name: temperature
fields.description: Air temperature on the 500 hPa pressure level.

fields.name: temperature
fields.description: Air temperature on the 850 hPa pressure level.

fields.name: geopotential
fields.description: Geopotential on the 500 hPa pressure level.

defaults_used: Use product_type=reanalysis because the requested workflow did not ask for ensemble mean, spread, or members.
Use global geographic coverage because the user did not specify a sub-region.
Use UTC hourly time labels and select every third hour from the ERA5 hourly time options.
Keep only the selected temperature and geopotential variables rather than enumerating the full ERA5 pressure-level inventory.
assumptions: The requested field set includes temperature at 500 hPa, temperature at 850 hPa, and geopotential at 500 hPa.
No spatial subset was provided, so the contract remains global until a human narrows it.
The workflow wants instantaneous hourly reanalysis fields sampled every 3 hours, not daily or monthly aggregates.
risks_or_unknowns: A single provider request using both variables and both pressure levels may return geopotential at 850 hPa as well; implementation should preserve the field-selector pairing in this contract or split requests if needed.
No ML field roles, prediction horizon, train/test split, or label alignment rule was specified.
No preferred output format was specified; NetCDF is suggested for ML convenience but GRIB is the dataset page default.
CDS access requires a registered account, personal access token for API use, and acceptance of dataset terms; credentials must be referenced by name only and not embedded in requests.

advanced_options.implementation_hint: If using CDS request syntax directly, consider separate requests for temperature levels [500,850] and geopotential level [500] to avoid retrieving unused geopotential at 850 hPa.

contract.recommended_next_step: Confirm whether the global spatial domain is intended or provide a bounding box; then confirm output format, with NetCDF suggested for most ML workflows.
